playstyle-desc-preset-roughseas: Standard survival on a world with open oceans, where wind, storms and the sea are dangerous.
worldattribute-bilgeWater-desc: Waves break aboard and rain falls into an open vessel, filling its bilge until you bail it out. Off, no wave or rain adds water; a leak still does.
worldattribute-hullDamage-desc: Rocks, the shore, rams, rapids, breakers and the weather crack a hull, and a crack leaks. Hide rots, ungreased seams seep and reed soaks up water. Off, no hull takes harm, and every hull is mended whole.
worldattribute-stormLightning-desc: Storms strike lightning near you, and a mast draws it.
worldattribute-mooringStrain-desc: A storm drags anchors, snaps mooring ropes and throws a vessel moored while you are away onto the shore.
worldattribute-oceanCurrents-desc: Currents and the wind carry away a vessel nobody steers.
worldattribute-rowerFatigue-desc: Rowing, paddling and poling make you hungry.
worldattribute-poleDepth-desc: A pole pushes only where it reaches the bottom. Off, it pushes in water of any depth as at its full stroke.
